message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large-format magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in white capital letters. A main caricature figure in a white tuxedo with a black bow tie smiles prominently in the foreground. He holds a unique object: a piece of cut wood trunk with green foliage sprouting from its top, resembling a miniature forest on a platter. His hands are positioned around its base. Behind him, numerous identical smaller figures in dark green suits and orange ties raise their hands, some clapping. These background figures have simplified, repetitive facial features. 

The top of the cover contains several lines of text: "Modus Penyelewengan Kredit Sritex H.40" and "Intimidasi Penentang Undang-Undang TNI H.30". A headline reads "JAYA DI RIMBA TAIPAN KOTA", followed by a paragraph starting with "Ratusan perusahaan mengantre konsesi baru..." and ending with "H.78". A silver "54" logo appears near the title. At the bottom, there is a barcode, a QR code, the date "2-8 JUNI 2024", the price "RP 60.000", and other publication details. The background is a solid ochre color.
